description: This file defines the 'MerchantStore' entity class representing a merchant's store with its properties, relationships, and configurations in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: MerchantStore
classes.description: Entity class representing a merchant's store with various attributes such as name, code, contact info, location, language preferences, currencies, and other configurations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the store.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the store.

methods.name: getStorename
methods.description: Returns the name of the store.

methods.name: setStorename
methods.description: Sets the name of the store.

methods.name: getStorephone
methods.description: Returns the store's contact phone number.

methods.name: setStorephone
methods.description: Sets the store's contact phone number.

methods.name: getStoreaddress
methods.description: Returns the store's address.

methods.name: setStoreaddress
methods.description: Sets the store's address.

methods.name: getStorecity
methods.description: Returns the city where the store is located.

methods.name: setStorecity
methods.description: Sets the city where the store is located.

methods.name: getStorepostalcode
methods.description: Returns the postal code of the store's location.

methods.name: setStorepostalcode
methods.description: Sets the postal code of the store's location.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country associated with the store.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country associated with the store.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the zone/region of the store.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the zone/region of the store.

methods.name: getStorestateprovince
methods.description: Returns the state or province of the store.

methods.name: setStorestateprovince
methods.description: Sets the state or province of the store.

methods.name: getWeightunitcode
methods.description: Returns the weight unit code used for the store.

methods.name: setWeightunitcode
methods.description: Sets the weight unit code used for the store.

methods.name: getSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Returns the size/volume unit code used for the store.

methods.name: setSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Sets the size/volume unit code used for the store.

methods.name: getInBusinessSince
methods.description: Returns the date when the store started business, cloned to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setInBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the date when the store started business, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language of the store.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language of the store.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns the list of languages supported by the store.

methods.name: setLanguages
methods.description: Sets the list of languages supported by the store.

methods.name: isUseCache
methods.description: Returns whether cache is used for the store.

methods.name: setUseCache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache for the store.

methods.name: getStoreLogo
methods.description: Returns the store's logo filename/path.

methods.name: setStoreLogo
methods.description: Sets the store's logo filename/path.

methods.name: getStoreTemplate
methods.description: Returns the store's template name.

methods.name: setStoreTemplate
methods.description: Sets the store's template name.

methods.name: getInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Returns the invoice template used by the store.

methods.name: setInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Sets the invoice template used by the store.

methods.name: getDomainName
methods.description: Returns the store's domain name.

methods.name: setDomainName
methods.description: Sets the store's domain name.

methods.name: getContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Returns the continue shopping URL.

methods.name: setContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Sets the continue shopping URL.

methods.name: getStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the store's contact email address.

methods.name: setStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the store's contact email address.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the store's code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the store's code.

methods.name: getDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Returns the date representing when the store started business.

methods.name: setDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the date representing when the store started business.

methods.name: isCurrencyFormatNational
methods.description: Returns whether the currency format is national.

methods.name: setCurrencyFormatNational
methods.description: Sets whether to use national currency format.
